newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms Videotron senior notes.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms Videotron senior notes.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Wednesday that it confirmed ratings for Groupe Videotron Ltee's senior notes and commercial paper, but downgraded its senior debentures and notes.
DBRS said it reduced the rating on Videotron's senior secured debentures to BBB from BBB (high), and downgraded its senior subordinated debentures to BBB (low) from BBB, each with a stable trend.
The rating reduction reflects the expectation that cable companies will come under growing competitive pressure as regulation eases and technology improves, DBRS said.
The rating reduction also reflects the expectation that the battle between cable, telephone and direct broadcast satellite services is heating up, the agency said.
In addition, despite the recent divestiture of its U.K. operations, the company's balance sheet is expected to remain under pressure, reflecting future capital expenditure requirements, DBRS said.
DBRS confirmed the R-2 (high) rating on Videotron's commercial paper, and confirmed the BB (high) rating on Videotron's senior notes.

Despite Videotron's lead position in Quebec, it can expect to encounter competition from new entrants in its main service area over time. The company will need to improve its financial flexibility to deal with well capitalized entrants such as the telephone companies, DBRS said.
